TacticalIdentity: Highest-skill-ceiling Mancer — derives power from repeating the best spell cast on the battlefield at 60% power for 2 AP. Places Afterimage decoys that are visually identical to the Echomancer; destroyed Afterimages explode for 12 Arcane AoE. Phase Step swaps position with any active Afterimage. TEMPORAL ECHO forces an enemy Mancer to undo their last 2 turns of movement and actions.

Spells.Description: A pure Arcane projectile that deals exactly 10 damage with no terrain interactions, no secondary status, and no elemental modifications. Ignores all terrain interaction tables. Pierces OBSIDIAN. Destroys an Afterimage in a single hit if it has already taken damage.

TerrainChanges.Description: Arcane energy dissipates CHARGED terrain harmlessly — clears CHARGED without triggering arc chain

Spells.Description: Places a decoy token on any visible tile within range. The Afterimage is visually identical to the Echomancer. It has 10 HP and explodes for 12 Arcane AoE (1-tile radius) when destroyed. Maximum 3 Afterimages active simultaneously. Placing a 4th collapses the oldest with no explosion.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Echomancer-triggered Afterimage destruction deals 18 AoE (up from 12)

AppliedEffects.Description: Places Afterimage token (10 HP). Visually identical to Echomancer. Explodes for 12 Arcane AoE in 1-tile radius on destruction. Immune to POISONED and ROOTED. Does not conduct electricity on CHARGED terrain.

Spells.Description: Repeats the last spell cast by any Mancer on either team at 60% of its base damage and 60% status effect application probability. Inherits the original spell's element, range, AoE, and all terrain interactions. 1-turn cooldown prevents echoing the same spell twice in a row. Echo target updates every time any Mancer casts.

ConditionalBonuses.Description: Echo deals 60% of last spell's base damage; secondary effects apply at 60% probability per target

AppliedEffects.Description: Fires at last qualifying spell's target location from Echomancer's current position. Inherits element, AoE, range, and terrain interactions. Excluded spells: Phase Step, Afterimage, Temporal Echo, Chronomancer REWIND, any spell cast by the Echomancer this activation.

Spells.Description: Instantly swaps positions with a chosen active Afterimage. The Echomancer teleports to the Afterimage's tile; the Afterimage token moves to the Echomancer's prior tile. No range limit — can target any visible Afterimage on the board. Terrain hazards at the destination apply normally after the swap.

AppliedEffects.Description: Echomancer teleports to target Afterimage's tile. Afterimage moves to Echomancer's prior tile. No path travel, no collision. Destination must have an active Afterimage. Afterimage HP unaffected by swap.

Spells.Description: Forces one enemy Mancer to undo their last 2 turns of movement and actions. The target is repositioned to their location 2 turns ago with full 6 AP. Statuses gained in the last 2 turns are stripped. Board damage, terrain states, and effects on other units from those turns are NOT reversed. If the target used their Signature Ability in the 2-turn window, its cooldown is restored but its effects remain. Echomancer cannot move this turn.

AppliedEffects.Description: Target Mancer's position reset to 2 turns ago. AP refunded to 6 (base). Statuses applied in last 2 turns removed. Signature ability cooldown restored if used in window. Cannot target units in STASIS. Board state (terrain, damage dealt) not reverted.
